services.name: 86 Azimut Luxury Yacht Miami Private Charter

includes: Full water-toy package (62 Azimut and 86 Azimut)
blurb: Guests book private charters on various yachts and a large catamaran for groups from 12 to 115. Charters include a USCG-licensed captain and crew, with options for hostess service and water toys. Routes cover Biscayne Bay, Star Island, Government Cut, and offshore trips to Bimini.
tags: 86 Azimut Luxury Yacht Miami Private Charter
extraNote: Deposits vary by duration: $399 for 2 hours, $1,000 for 4 hours, $1,200 for 6 hours, $1,500 for full day · Cancellation refund schedule: 100% if cancelled 7+ days before; 75% at 5 days; 50% at 72 hours; 25% at 48 hours; no refund within 24 hours · Written email cancellation required · Captain and crew gratuity not included; suggested minimum 18% for catamaran, $50 per booked hour suggested for sport yachts · Marina location assigned by operator after booking, either Miami Beach Marina or Bayside Marketplace.

quotes.text: Captain Erik was amazing — saw dolphins and stingrays, and made the Miami Beach snorkeling unforgettable! A truly private, luxury experience.

quotes.text: Captain Nico and the team made our sunset cruise unforgettable. They made our family tour comfortable, fun, and incredibly safe.

quotes.author: Shalonda Black
quotes.text: Shalonda Black7 months agoThe kindness, courtesy, and hospitality Mario and Nico showed my family on our first ever snorkeling adventure was amazing. The explanation of the process and the patience Nico exhibited made the experience enjoyable. Nico was a great captain on our private boat tour. Very personable. I couldn’t swim but he jumped in the water and was the guide for myself and family so we could experience the beautiful sites under the water. The cost was reasonable and definitely worth it (the tour and snorkeling). A must do!

quotes.author: Stacy Tran 3 years ago
quotes.text: Felipe was personal, friendly, and very patient. You can tell he enjoys this job. I had a 10-year-old son with me snorkeling for the very first time. My son was so comfortable with him that he held on to the float and snorkel while Felipe dragged him in the water. It was a private boat tour and snorkel. Beautiful view of all the high rises and Felipe filled us in the history. Thank you Felipe for making it memorable.
